children: Grades eased on Wednesday, dealers said, as US West Texas Intermediate crude's discount to Brent narrowed during the session.
US crude inventories fell by 1.9 million barrels to 410.6 million barrels in the week ended October 23, the EIA said, compared with analysts' expectations in a Reuters poll for a 15,000-barrel rise.

Yemen's Houthis attacked Aden airport on Wednesday, Yemeni government forces said, after the Iran-aligned group warned people to evacuate the facility as fighting escalated in the impoverished country caught in the wider Middle East conflict.
US West Texas Intermediate crude's discount to Brent narrowed to as little as minus $12.15, the smallest discount since October 22. A smaller discount hurts exports.
Light Louisiana Sweet (WTC-LLS) for December delivery eased to a midpoint of a $3.10 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $2.00 and $4.20 a barrel premium to US crude futures
Mars Sour (WTC-MRS) eased 50 cents to a midpoint of a $2 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $1.75 and $2.25 a barrel premium to US crude futures
WTI Midland  (WTC-WTM) eased 5 cents to a midpoint of a 45-cent premium and was seen bid and offered between a 25-cent and 65-cent a barrel premium to US crude futures
West Texas Sour (WTC-WTS)  eased 60 cents to a midpoint of a $1.35 discount and was seen bid and offered between a $1.55 and $1.15 a barrel discount to US crude futures
WTI at East Houston (WTC-MEH), also known as MEH, traded between a 60-cent and $1.00 a barrel premium to US crude futures
rose $1.44 to settle at $115.32 a barrel on Wednesday​.
futures rose $2.88 to settle at $102.0 8 a barrel on Wednesday​.
The Brent/WTI spread (WTCLc1-LCOc1) narrowed $1.83 to last trade at minus $12.15, after hitting a high of minus $12.15 and a low of  minus $14.62.
